using System;

using System.Collections.Generic;

using System.Linq;

using System.Text;

using System.Threading.Tasks;

using System.Drawing;

 

namespace FiringRudal

{

    class TwoPlayer

    {

        public TwoPlayer ()

        {

        }

 

        public Image MyImage;

        public Rectangle Location;

        public bool IsVisible = false ;

 

        public void Place(Graphics g)

        {

            g.DrawImage( this .MyImage, this .Location);

            this .IsVisible = true ;

        }

 

        public void Move(Graphics g, Brush bc, int dx, int dy)

        {

            g.FillRectangle(bc, this .Location);

            this .Location.X += dx;

            this .Location.Y += dy;

            g.DrawImage( this .MyImage, this .Location);

        }

 

        public void Remove(Graphics g, Brush bc)

        {

            g.FillRectangle(bc, this .Location);

            this .IsVisible = false ;

        }

    }

}

using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace FiringRudal

{

    public partial class FormFightingPlane : Form

    {

        int NumberOfPlayer, Difficulty;

        Graphics MyGraphics;

        Brush MyBrush;

        TwoPlayer Player1, Player2;

        int Player1Hit, Player2Hit, Player1Rem, Player2Rem;

        const int RudalMax = 20;

        const int PlayerIncrement = 10;

 

        MovingFire Rudal1, Rudal2;

        const int RudalSpeed = 30;

 

        MovingFire Ufo1, Ufo2;

        Random MyRandom = new Random();

 

        SoundPlayer SoundFire, SoundHit, SoundOuch, SoundGameOver;

        int RandComputer, TimeComputer;

 

        public FormFightingPlane ()

        {

            InitializeComponent();

        }

 

        private void btnOption_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            btnGame.Enabled = false ;

            btnOption.Enabled = false ;

            btnExit.Enabled = false ;

            pnlOption.Visible = true ;

            lblInstructionPlayer2.Visible = false ;

        }

 

        private void btnUp_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            SendKeys.Send( "A" ); // Moves up

        }

 

        private void btnDown_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            SendKeys.Send( "Z" ); // Moves down

        }

 

        private void btnFire_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            SendKeys.Send( "S" ); // Fires

        }

 

        private void btnUp2_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            Player2.Move(MyGraphics, MyBrush, 0, -PlayerIncrement);

            if (Player2.Location.Y < 0)

                Player2.Location.Y = 0;

        }

 

        private void btnDown2_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            Player2.Move(MyGraphics, MyBrush, 0, PlayerIncrement);

            if (Player2.Location.Y >

                    pnlGame.ClientSize.Height - Player2.Location.Height)

                Player2.Location.Y =

                    pnlGame.ClientSize.Height - Player2.Location.Height;

        }

 

        private void btnFire2_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            if (!Rudal2.IsVisible && Player2Rem > 0)

            {

                SoundFire.Play();

                Player2Rem--;

                lblRemPlayer2.Text = Player2Rem.ToString();

                Rudal2.Location =

                    new Rectangle(Player2.Location.X - Player2.Location.Width,

                    Player2.Location.Y, Rudal1.MyImage.Width,

                    Rudal1.MyImage.Height);

                Rudal2.Place(MyGraphics);

            }

        }

 

        private void FormFightingPlane_Load( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            try

            {

                StreamReader fileInput = new

                    StreamReader(Application.StartupPath

                    + "\\plane.ini" );

                NumberOfPlayer = Convert.ToInt32(fileInput.ReadLine());

                Difficulty = Convert.ToInt32(fileInput.ReadLine());

                fileInput.Close();              

            }

            catch

            {

                NumberOfPlayer = 1;

                Difficulty = 1;

            }

 

            // Makes form visible so options can be clicked

            this .Show();

            pnlOption.Visible = true ;

 

            if (Difficulty == 1)

                rdoEasiest.PerformClick();

            else if (Difficulty == 2)

                rdoEasy.PerformClick();

            else if (Difficulty == 3)

                rdoHard.PerformClick();

            else

                rdoHardest.PerformClick();

 

            if (NumberOfPlayer == 1)

                rdoOnePlayer.PerformClick();

            else

                rdoTwoPlayers.PerformClick();

 

            pnlOption.Visible = false ;

 

            Player1Rem = RudalMax;

            Player2Rem = RudalMax;

            lblRemPlayer1.Text = Player1Rem.ToString();

            lblRemPlayer2.Text = Player2Rem.ToString();

 

            // Creates TwoPlayer objects

            MyGraphics = pnlGame.CreateGraphics();

            MyBrush = new SolidBrush(pnlGame.BackColor);

            Player1 = new TwoPlayer();

            Player2 = new TwoPlayer();

            Player1.MyImage = Image.FromFile(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\bomber1.png" );

            Player2.MyImage = Image.FromFile(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\bomber2.png" );

 

            Rudal1 = new MovingFire();

            Rudal2 = new MovingFire();

            Rudal1.MyImage = Image.FromFile(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\rudal4.png" );

            Rudal2.MyImage = Image.FromFile(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\rudal2.png" );

 

            Ufo1 = new MovingFire();

            Ufo2 = new MovingFire();

            Ufo1.MyImage = Image.FromFile(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\ufo2.png" );

            Ufo2.MyImage = Image.FromFile(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\ufo4.png" );

 

            SoundFire = new SoundPlayer(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\throw.wav" );

            SoundHit = new SoundPlayer(Application.StartupPath + "\\hit.wav" );

            SoundOuch = new SoundPlayer(Application.StartupPath + "\\ouch.wav" );

            SoundGameOver = new SoundPlayer(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\gameover.wav" );

            SoundFire.Load();

            SoundHit.Load();

            SoundOuch.Load();

 

            btnGame.Focus();

        }

 

        private void rdoPlayer_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            RadioButton ButtonClicked;

            ButtonClicked = (RadioButton) sender;

 

            if (ButtonClicked.Text == "One" )

            {

                NumberOfPlayer = 1;

                lblPlayer1.Text = "You:" ;

                lblPlayer2.Text = "Computer:" ;

                lblInstructionPlayer2.Visible = false ;

                grpDifficulty.Enabled = true ;

            }

 

            else

            {

                NumberOfPlayer = 2;

                lblPlayer1.Text = "Player 1:" ;

                lblPlayer2.Text = "Player 2:" ;

                lblInstructionPlayer2.Visible = true ;

                grpDifficulty.Enabled = false ;

            }

        }

 

        private void rdoDifficulty_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            RadioButton ButtonClicked;

            ButtonClicked = (RadioButton)sender;

 

            switch (ButtonClicked.Text)

            {

                case "Easiest" :

                    Difficulty = 1;

                    RandComputer = 100;

                    TimeComputer = 1000;

                    break ;

                case "Easy" :

                    Difficulty = 2;

                    RandComputer = 75;

                    TimeComputer = 750;

                    break ;

                case "Hard" :

                    Difficulty = 3;

                    RandComputer = 50;

                    TimeComputer = 500;

                    break ;

                case "Hardest" :

                    Difficulty = 4;

                    RandComputer = 25;

                    TimeComputer = 250;

                    break ;

            }

            timComputer.Interval = TimeComputer;

        }

 

        private void btnOK_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            btnGame.Enabled = true ;

            btnOption.Enabled = true ;

            btnExit.Enabled = true ;

            pnlOption.Visible = false ;

        }

 

        private void FormFightingPlane_FormClosing( object sender, FormClosingEventArgs e)

        {

            StreamWriter FileOutput = new StreamWriter(Application.StartupPath +

                "\\plane.ini" );

            FileOutput.WriteLine(NumberOfPlayer);

            FileOutput.WriteLine(Difficulty);

            FileOutput.Close();

        }

 

        private void btnExit_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            this .Close();

        }

 

        private void btnGame_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            if (btnGame.Text == "New Game" )

            {

                MyGraphics.Clear(pnlGame.BackColor);

                btnGame.Text = "Stop Game" ;

                btnOption.Enabled = false ;

                btnExit.Enabled = false ;

                Player1Hit = 0;

                Player2Hit = 0;

                lblHitPlayer1.Text = "0" ;

                lblHitPlayer2.Text = "0" ;

                Player1Rem = RudalMax;

                Player2Rem = RudalMax;

                lblRemPlayer1.Text = Player1Rem.ToString();

                lblRemPlayer2.Text = Player2Rem.ToString();

                Player1.Location =

                    new Rectangle(5, ( int )(0.5 * pnlGame.ClientSize.Height - 0.5 *

                    Player1.MyImage.Height), Player1.MyImage.Width,

                    Player1.MyImage.Height);

                Player2.Location =

                   new Rectangle(pnlGame.ClientSize.Width –

                   Player2.MyImage.Width - 5,

                   ( int )(0.5 * pnlGame.ClientSize.Height - 0.5 *

                   Player2.MyImage.Height), Player2.MyImage.Width,

                   Player2.MyImage.Height);

                Player1.Place(MyGraphics);

                Player2.Place(MyGraphics);

 

                Ufo1.Location =

                    new Rectangle(( int )(0.5 * pnlGame.ClientSize.Width –

                    Ufo1.MyImage.Width),

                    MyRandom.Next(pnlGame.ClientSize.Height),

                    Ufo1.MyImage.Width, Ufo1.MyImage.Height);

                Ufo2.Location = new Rectangle(( int )(0.5 *

                    pnlGame.ClientSize.Width),

                    MyRandom.Next(pnlGame.ClientSize.Height),

                    Ufo2.MyImage.Width,

                    Ufo2.MyImage.Height);

                Ufo1.YSpeed = UfoSpeed();

                Ufo2.YSpeed = UfoSpeed();

                Ufo1.Place(MyGraphics);

                Ufo2.Place(MyGraphics);

 

                timGame.Enabled = true ;

 

                if (NumberOfPlayer == 1)

                    timComputer.Enabled = true ;

 

                this .Focus();

            }

            else

            {

                timComputer.Enabled = false ;

                timGame.Enabled = false ;

                Player1.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                Player2.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                Rudal1.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                Rudal2.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                Ufo1.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                Ufo2.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                btnGame.Text = "New Game" ;

                btnOption.Enabled = true ;

                btnExit.Enabled = true ;

                MyGraphics.DrawString( "Game Over" , new Font( "Arial" , 24),

                    Brushes.Yellow, 530, 210);

            }

        }

 

        private int UfoSpeed()

        {

            const int SpeedMin = 1;

            const int SpeedMax = 4;

            int Speed;

            Speed = MyRandom.Next(SpeedMax - SpeedMin + 1) + SpeedMin;

            if (MyRandom.Next(2) == 0)

                Speed = -Speed;

            return (Speed);

        }

 

        private void FormFightingPlane_KeyDown( object sender, KeyEventArgs e)

        {

            if (btnGame.Text == "New Game" )

                return ;

            switch (e.KeyCode)

            {

                case Keys.A:

                    Player1.Move(MyGraphics, MyBrush, 0, -PlayerIncrement);

                    if (Player1.Location.Y < 0)

                        Player1.Location.Y = 0;

                    break ;

                case Keys.Z:

                    Player1.Move(MyGraphics, MyBrush, 0, PlayerIncrement);

                    if (Player1.Location.Y >

                            pnlGame.ClientSize.Height - Player1.Location.Height)

                        Player1.Location.Y =

                            pnlGame.ClientSize.Height - Player1.Location.Height;

                    break ;

 

                case Keys.S:

                    if (!Rudal1.IsVisible && Player1Rem > 0)

                    {

                        SoundFire.Play();

                        Player1Rem--;

                        lblRemPlayer1.Text = Player1Rem.ToString();

                        Rudal1.Location =

                            new Rectangle(Player1.Location.X +

                            Player1.Location.Width,

                            Player1.Location.Y, Rudal1.MyImage.Width,

                            Rudal1.MyImage.Height);

                        Rudal1.Place(MyGraphics);

                    }

                    break ;

 

                case Keys.K:

                    btnUp2.PerformClick();

                    break ;

                case Keys.M:

                    btnDown2.PerformClick();

                    break ;

 

                case Keys.J:

                    btnFire2.PerformClick();

                    break ;

            }

        }

 

        private void timGame_Tick( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            // Moves shield

            Ufo1.Move(MyGraphics, MyBrush, 0, Ufo1.YSpeed);

            if (Ufo1.Location.Y < -Ufo1.MyImage.Height ||

                Ufo1.Location.Y > pnlGame.ClientSize.Height)

            {

                // Recalculates speed

                Ufo1.YSpeed = UfoSpeed();

 

                if (Ufo1.YSpeed > 0)

                {

                    Ufo1.Location.Y = -Ufo1.MyImage.Height;

                }

                else

                    Ufo1.Location.Y = pnlGame.ClientSize.Height;

            }

 

            Ufo2.Move(MyGraphics, MyBrush, 0, Ufo2.YSpeed);

            if (Ufo2.Location.Y < -Ufo2.MyImage.Height ||

                Ufo2.Location.Y > pnlGame.ClientSize.Height)

            {

                // Recalculates speed

                Ufo2.YSpeed = UfoSpeed();

 

                if (Ufo2.YSpeed > 0)

                    Ufo2.Location.Y = -Ufo2.MyImage.Height;

                else

                    Ufo2.Location.Y = pnlGame.ClientSize.Height;

            }

 

            // status of fire thrown by player 1

            if (Rudal1.IsVisible)

            {

                Rudal1.Move(MyGraphics, MyBrush, RudalSpeed, 0);

                if (Rudal1.Location.X > pnlGame.ClientSize.Width)

                    // past the edge of the panel

                    Rudal1.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

 

                else if (Rudal1.Collide(Player2.Location))

                {

                    SoundOuch.Play();

                    Player1Hit++;

                    lblHitPlayer1.Text = Player1Hit.ToString();

                    Rudal1.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                }

 

                else if (Rudal1.Collide(Ufo1.Location) ||

                    Rudal1.Collide(Ufo2.Location))

                {

                    SoundHit.Play();

                    Rudal1.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                }

 

            }

 

            //status of fire thrown fby player 2

            if (Rudal2.IsVisible)

            {

                Rudal2.Move(MyGraphics, MyBrush, -RudalSpeed, 0);

                if (Rudal2.Location.X < 0)

                    // past the edge of the panel

                    Rudal2.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

 

                else if (Rudal2.Collide(Player1.Location))

                {

                    SoundOuch.Play();

                    Player2Hit++;

                    lblHitPlayer2.Text = Player2Hit.ToString();

                    Rudal2.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                }

 

                else if (Rudal2.Collide(Ufo1.Location) ||

                    Rudal2.Collide(Ufo2.Location))

                {

                    SoundHit.Play();

                    Rudal2.Remove(MyGraphics, MyBrush);

                }

            }

 

            // Checks game status

            if (!Rudal1.IsVisible && Player1Rem == 0 && !Rudal2.IsVisible &&

                Player2Rem == 0)

            {

                SoundGameOver.PlaySync();

                btnGame.PerformClick();

            }

        }

 

        private void timComputer_Tick( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            int i;

            if (MyRandom.Next(100) < RandComputer)

            {

                i = MyRandom.Next(5); // Moves randomly

                if (i == 0)

                {

                    if (Player2Rem >= Player1Rem)

                        btnFire2.PerformClick(); // Fires rudal

                }

                else if (i <= 2)

                    btnUp2.PerformClick(); // Moves up

                else

                    btnDown2.PerformClick(); // Moves down

            }

            else

            {

                if (Math.Abs(Player1.Location.Y - Player2.Location.Y) <

                       ( int )(0.8 * Player1.MyImage.Height) &&

                       Player2Rem >= Player1Rem)

                    btnFire2.PerformClick(); // Fires rudal

                if (Rudal1.IsVisible || Player2Rem == 0)

                {

                    if (Player1.Location.Y - Player2.Location.Y < 0)

                        btnUp2.PerformClick(); // Moves up

                    else

                        btnDown2.PerformClick(); // Moves down

                }

                else

                {

                    if (Player1.Location.Y - Player2.Location.Y < 0)

                        btnUp2.PerformClick(); // Moves up

                    else

                        btnDown2.PerformClick(); // Moves down

                }

            }

        }

    }

}
